style: cute 2D game art for a cozy virtual office in the style of Gather.town and ZEP: top-down 3/4 camera (seen from the front and slightly above), clean rounded shapes, soft cel shading, thin dark outline, warm friendly palette, no text, no letters, no logos
background: Perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background everywhere, no floor, no cast shadow on the background, no border, no grid lines.

character.sheet: A game character sprite sheet. Chibi proportions: big round head about 40% of the body height, small body. Layout: a strict 4 columns x 4 rows grid of equal square cells, one full-body figure per cell, every figure the same size and scale, feet on the same baseline near the bottom of its cell, nothing crossing cell borders. Row 1: walking toward the viewer (front view), 4 frames of a smooth walk cycle. Row 2: walking to the right (side view, facing right), 4 frames of a walk cycle. Row 3: walking away from the viewer (back view), 4 frames of a walk cycle. Row 4, front view: standing idle; typing with both hands forward (pose A); typing (pose B, hands moved); standing asleep with eyes closed.

fx.prompt: A sheet of 10 small status icons for a game UI, bold and readable at small size, chunky shapes with a dark outline. Layout: a strict 5 columns x 2 rows grid of equal square cells, one centered icon per cell, nothing crossing cell borders. Row 1, left to right: a lavender thought cloud with three dots; a white speech bubble with three dots; an open blue book; a yellow pencil; a magnifying glass. Row 2, left to right: a dark terminal window showing a green ">_" prompt; a glowing teal electric plug with a small lightning bolt; two small people side by side; a steaming coffee mug; the letters "Zz" in a soft blue cloud.

texture.prompt: A seamless tileable floor texture for a cozy 2D virtual office game like Gather.town and ZEP, seen straight from above (no perspective, no horizon), flat even lighting, no shadows, no objects, no text, soft stylized cartoon look with gentle low-contrast detail. The pattern fills the whole square image edge to edge.
